titleEn: Partition String Into Substrings With Values at Most K
title: 将字符串分割成值不超过 K 的子字符串
summary: 把数字字符串分成尽量少的连续非空子串，每段解释为整数后不超过 k；无法分割返回负一。
insight: 为了让段数最少，每一段都应尽量向右延伸。扫描时若加入下一位会超过 k，就在该位之前切分；若单个数字已超过 k 则无解。
pitfalls: 拼接时用 long 防止中间溢出

solutions.title: 贪心取最长合法段
solutions.idea: 每次切出当前起点能取得的最长前缀。
steps: 扫描 digit，若 digit>k 返回 -1

code.java: class Solution { public int minimumPartition(String s,int k){int parts=1;long current=0;for(char character:s.toCharArray()){int digit=character-'0';if(digit>k)return -1;if(current*10+digit>k){parts++;current=digit;}else current=current*10+digit;}return parts;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minimumPartition(s:String,k:Int):Int{var parts=1;var current=0L;for(character in s){val digit=character-'0';if(digit>k)return -1;if(current*10+digit>k){parts++;current=digit.toLong()}else current=current*10+digit};return parts} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int minimumPartition(string s,int k){int parts=1;long long current=0;for(char character:s){int digit=character-'0';if(digit>k)return -1;if(current*10+digit>k){++parts;current=digit;}else current=current*10+digit;}return parts;} };
